# while, endwhile

Repeats.

```ttl
while <expression>

  ...

  ...

endwhile
```

## Remarks

Repeats the statements between 'while' and 'endwhile' while &lt;expression&gt; is non-zero.

## Example

```ttl
; Repeat ten times.
i = 10
while i>0
  i = i - 1
endwhile
```
